pages.name: Two Knights Defence, Main Line, 11.d4 exd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...Qc7 pressuring an e4-pawn that was taken en passant; rewritten around the queen and d6-bishop battery on h2. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Steinitz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a ...d4 break with no black d-pawn; plan 3 sent the knight to f2, where White's pawn stands; overview named 8.Be2 instead of 9.Nh3. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Steinitz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 used ...d5, ...c6 and ...d4, with no black d-pawn and the c-pawn already on c6; plan 2 sent the knight to f2 with the pawn still there. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Steinitz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 said ...g4 traps the h3-knight (it still has g1) and plan 2 rerouted it via f2. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defense, Steinitz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a ...d4 break with no d-pawn and claimed a bishop pair both sides have; plan 2 rerouted via f2 with the pawn there. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Main Line, 11.d4 exd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 challenged an e4-pawn already taken en passant; overview rewritten (reviewer rejected the first wording, which said 11.d4 strikes at e4; it supports the e5-knight; fixed and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Main Line, 11.d4 exd3 12.Nxd3 Qc7
pages.notes: Plans 1 and 2 used an e4-pawn and a central black pawn that no longer exist; rewritten around h3 or b3 with Bb2 and the battery on h2. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Main Line, 11.d4 Qc7
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed ...f5-f4 through the f6-knight; plan 3 took en passant a move too late. Rewritten; reviewer rejected a ...Nc4 route that drops the knight, so it was removed and accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Main Line, 11.d4, Honfi Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 relied on an e4-pawn that is gone. Rewritten around 13.b3 controlling c4 and preparing Bb2 (reviewer rejected the first wording, that Bb2 was needed to castle; fixed and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Main Line, 11.f4 exf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 attacked a non-existent d5-pawn; overview said 11.f4 challenges e4 rather than supporting the e5-knight. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Steinitz Variation
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-22-22: the revised plan 2 sent the h3-knight to f4, which the e5-pawn covers; now via f2 once the f-pawn has moved.
